item.title: Estonia to close border crossings with Russia after alleged arson attack
item.description:
Authorities say Russian intelligence service ordered attack Estonian PM links to Tallinn’s support for Ukraine Estonia will close all its border crossings with Russia from 1 December after a suspected sabotage attack on a drone maker in the Baltic state over the weekend, which authorities said was ordered by Russia’s GRU military intelligence service. On Saturday morning, eight people were detained during an attempted attack on Threod Systems, a defence company that manufactures long-range attack and reconnaissance drones. No injuries or damage were reported after the company’s security team responded to the incident. Continue reading...

item.title: Nearly 2,200 migrants reach Spain's Canary Islands in two days
item.description:
Nearly 2,200 migrants have reached the Canary Islands over the past two days, Spain’s coastguard said Sunday, continuing a recent surge of arrivals from West African countries to the Spanish archipelago, where the authorities declared a migration emergency earlier this week.

item.title: Israel kills senior member of Hamas's military wing in Gaza strike
item.description:
Throughout Israel’s war on Palestine, doctors Thaer Ahmad and Feroze Sidhwa spent months at Nasser Hospital in the southern Gaza city of Khan Younis, where they provided care as volunteers and survived a raid and an airstrike on the complex. On Wednesday evening, they were in an Uber in New York headed to a screening of their film about their time in Gaza when they realized Nasser was the target of another Israeli airstrike. “They just hit Nasser again,” Ahmad said, turning from the front seat toward Sidhwa. “I think Rizk is dead.” He was referring to Dr. Rizk Abu Shaaira, an experienced surgeon and fixture of the Palestinian medical community whom both had worked alongside at the hospital and who appears in their film “ American Doctor .” When Israel attacked Nasser Hospital on Wednesday — for at least the seventh time since the genocide escalated in 2023 — Abu Shaaira was one of the…

item.title: SpaceX’s Starship returns to launch pad from orbit – video
item.description:
SpaceX made history by catching the upper stage of the largest and most powerful rocket ever built as a pivotal step for the company in its aim to create the first fully reusable rocket. Starship Flight 15, which launched at 5:47 p.m. ET Friday from Starbase in South Texas, achieved the monumental feat of catching the upper stage — called Starship, or “Ship” — of the rocket using the launch tower’s “chopstick” arms on its return to Earth at 4:20 p.m. ET Saturday. item.title: Ebola outbreak remains out of control in Congo 6 months into response
item.description:
More than 11,000 cases have been recorded, and nearly half of those infected have died, according to government data. It is the deadliest of Congo's 17 outbreaks and is on track to surpass the death toll from the West African outbreak that killed 11,000 people between 2014 and 2016.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis advance on Aden as government forces retreat to defend their capital
item.description:
Houthi forces in Yemen have advanced to within 60 kilometres of Aden, the seat of the country's internationally recognised government, military and government sources said Sunday. The embattled government earlier announced it was pulling back its last forces from the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to defend its temporary capital on the southern coast of Yemen.
